subject.title: Implement v1 read-only Crabbox iOS coordinator companion

question: Who will approve the coordinator pairing/device-token API and its owner, revocation, trusted-origin, and read-only-scope guarantees before a fresh implementation PR begins?
rationale: The product direction and v1 non-goals are accepted, but the issue deliberately requires a new credential/security boundary whose exact server contract and review ownership cannot be safely inferred by automation.

options.title: Assign coordinator security ownership
options.body: Nominate an owner to approve a server-first pairing/token contract and require its focused tests before the SwiftUI client is reviewed.

options.title: Defer the mobile slice
options.body: Keep the accepted scope documented but pause implementation until security and mobile CI ownership are available.

recommendation.title: Assign coordinator security ownership
recommendation.body: Nominate an owner to approve a server-first pairing/token contract and require its focused tests before the SwiftUI client is reviewed.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the accepted scope and security contract and recently worked on coordinator credential redaction.
